generator.exhaustion_behavior: IT MUST BLOCK (never loosen constraints or choose a new seed)

family_grammar.connectivity: spanning path backbone R1->J1->...->JN (guarantees connectivity), plus `cycle_rank` deterministic extra edges (no multi-edges) to create loops
family_grammar.hydraulic_feasibility: must run cleanly under WNTR/EPANET hydraulics: finite pressures and min pressure >= 5.0 m under the preregistered baseline

rejection_criteria_permitted: impossible pressure/hydraulic state under the preregistered baseline
structural identity/isomorphism to a previously exposed topology

canonical_fingerprints: graph_signature {node_count, junction_count, link_count, cycle_rank, sorted degree_profile}
novelty.novelty_is_two_phase: (A) pre-serialization graph/network novelty: graph_signature + network_sha256 checked against PRIOR_TOPOLOGY_SIGNATURES / PRIOR_TOPOLOGY_NETWORK_HASHES and against the in-progress generated set; (B) post-serialization file-byte novelty: the exact materialized .inp bytes are hashed and must differ from every PRIOR_TOPOLOGY_FILES hash and from every other generated .inp file. Both phases must be computed before the novelty audit may report PASS.
novelty.rule: A locked_topology_test candidate is 'unseen' iff (a) its graph-structural signature (node/junction/link counts, cycle_rank, sorted degree profile) matches no prior topology signature, (b) its canonical network_sha256 is not in the frozen prior-hash set, and (c) for any materialized .inp file, its file-byte SHA-256 is not equal to any prior committed topology file hash. Duplicates WITHIN the generated locked_topology_test set are also rejected.
novelty.stronger_structural_novelty_note: All prior topologies have junction_count in [4, 8]; the frozen procedural generator is constrained to junction_count in [9, 12], so the node-count component of the signature is already decisive by construction. The full signature/hash checks above remain the frozen, mechanical novelty rule regardless.
